Perplexica architecture

Perplexica uses SearXNG as its meta-search backbone. The integration is 67 lines: a single HTTP call to /search?format=json&q=...&engines=a,b where focus modes compile into the engines parameter.

For academic searches the engines parameter becomes arxiv, scholar and pubmed. For discussions it becomes reddit. There is no fallback provider; SearXNG is a single point of failure in the pipeline.

Relevance is computed with embedding cosine similarity instead of a reranker model. Snippets below 0.5 similarity are filtered, and cross-source duplicates above 0.75 are merged before the top 20 pass to the answer stage.

The quality mode uses an LLM picker that selects at most three pages, then a Playwright lazy singleton fetches each page and Readability extracts the text content into 4000-token blocks with 500-token overlap for the per-chunk extractor.
